acceptanceCriteria: Routine task work uses ID-scoped AICockpit queries rather than raw canonical or generated file reads.
Broad state scans, imports, and exports display their scope and require explicit confirmation.
A documented operating budget limits repeated full-state commands within one work unit.
componentsAffected: Turn the incident read discipline into enforceable agent-facing operating checks and concise state queries.
testSteps: Command-contract tests and updated agent-facing guidance.

workItem.title: Enforce agent read budgets and token-churn operating checks
